title: Release Jutsu
body:
Syntax: perform release jutsu <player name>

Description: A level 100 technique, learned from a scroll, genuinely separate from Sealing Jutsu. Tears a Tailed Beast out of another player and releases it back into the world -- but only once you've already defeated that player in real combat. The beast spawns fresh, roaming and attackable again just like any other release.

Date: 2026-09-05
